messages.subject: CP Group | Cross-business strategy, sustainability and institutional leadership
messages.body:
Dear CP Group Leadership Team,

CP Group's scale across sectors and geographies creates a need for leaders who move comfortably between corporate priorities, government relationships and operating execution. That combination reflects my career.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My background spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, with current responsibilities covering government relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

I work across public institutions, communities, industry partners and internal functions on investment, compliance and reputation-sensitive priorities. I also bring direct energy-transition and carbon-governance exposure. This gives me a broad platform for cross-business country strategy and responsible growth.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, ASEAN or wider international mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff or country leadership. I have attached a CP Group-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
